asr.full_text: I just realized I'm wearing Victoria's Secret to do a tutorial on the Starbucks app. BASICNESS ACHIEVED!! And you guys and welcome back to my channel, I'm really excited. This is my first video I am shooting in my new office space. This space is very much still under construction. But as you saw in the beginning b-roll I share it a little bit with you guys I will have an office tour once this is all done I want to put a couple more pictures around here But I like having my cork board with the month and then letters like having my candle and my little fake plans because I don't have to water them and then just some other things around here that we'll get to Picture from when I was Mary Poppins is here. There's a lot of theater stuff going on, but I will also have a new computer when this all happens. But regardless, I wanted to try filming here a couple times before the official tour. Today's video is dedicated to the fearless Starbucks barista they handle a plethora of questions every day I have never personally been one so I cannot give a comment on it I'm only a spectator that sees it when they are in the Starbucks store but one of the things I have noticed are people are asking the baristas how to put their gift cards on their phone. And recently I was at a Starbucks and a woman from the front of the line, and there was a line of people behind her but she asked the barista how to put her gift card on her phone and he was completely kind, no knocking! Starbucks baristas, they are wonderful! He was so kind even with a line of people waiting, he explained to her how to do it. Let her do it. Didn't talk down to her. It was wonderful. And then when we got... And then when we got to the front of the line he explained that he gets this question all the time. Therefore I'm dedicating this video how to add your Starbucks gift card to your phone and how to transfer money and gifts back and forth via your app to all the Starbucks baristas out there fighting the good fight. Now, in order to do this, I'm going to scoot to my chair to my right and share my screen with you guys. You guys are now viewing my home screen which you will see to my left. Probably your right. If you look down, third row row first icon you see the Starbucks logo the angel go ahead and click that app or tap that app as they say and then your screen should look something like this if you look at the very top you see where it says pay stores gift order and music if you would at the very top you see where it says pay stores, gift, order and music. If you would like to add a Starbucks gift card go ahead and press pay. The first icon. From there you'll see how much you have on your balance how many stars you need to your next free point, at the bottom you'll see pay reload and manage. Click manage if you have a gift card at the very bottom of manage you see it says add Starbucks gift card go ahead and click that now you will see where they're asking for two sets of numbers the first set is these 16 digits there at the top of your card that say your Starbucks card number is there are 16 digits go ahead and click them in now. Then, if you have already done so, there will be a little bit of tape on top of the eight digits after that. Go ahead and peel that off if you have not already done so. That eight digit code goes on the bottom line, below the eight digit code goes on the bottom line below the sixteen digit code. Type that in. Once that is all done you have the 16 digits on the top and the 8 digit code on the bottom. Click at the very top right hand side it says Add. Click Add. Then from there you will see your exact Starbucks gift card at the top of your app payment plan. It actually matches the exactly on which I think is super cool. Then from there if you want to manage it or add it to your primary card you have the option do that as well also under the manage. I recommend putting all if your Starbucks gift cards onto one primary card that way You're not confused as to what card has how much on it From there you can click pay to go back to your main screen or you can just exit the app Easy as that how you add your gift card to your Starbucks app well? Wait? There's more you can also send Starbucks gifts to your friends like for example on my birthday my sister always sends me a Starbucks gift card because we live in different cities. It's just kind of her way of saying hey, I know it's your birthday – Happy Birthday! Go get some coffee. To do that, go back to your home screen, click gift, and you see a plethora of different options. We're going to choose this one for you. That looks pretty good. Then you can type-in your recipient and your message. She doesn't know I'm sending this to her so if she gives me a response before i post it i will link her response right there ya Have fun Katie im gonna send my sister $5 the minimum is $5 and the max is $50 for these little gift cards and i like that you don't need to tell them you can send them as a surprise anyway that is all for todays video i just wanted to share with you guys how you can take your gift card and add this amount to the app and how easy it is to send gifts to your friends who also have the app as well. If you found this video helpful, please give it a thumbs up and share it with anybody that you know that has a hard time adding gift cards to technology. There's no shame in how old they are. Old or young, it's completely fine. Once you see it, it's not that hard and you can get it for a really big price in there so keep adding card to card technology. There is no shame about how old they are but once you see them it is not that hard to find one that fits your needs. Anyway, If you like this video give it a thumbs up! If you are new to this channel hit the little red subscribe button down below and it will update you each and every time I upload a video. Leave me a comment down below if there is anyone you know that would benefit from this Or how much we love Starbucks Baristas Or your favorite drink from Starbucks Or anything else that I should do a review on No, this is more like a tutorial I wasn't reviewing anything There's anything If there's anything you think I should do a tutorial on That is as simple Leave a comment down below Either way just leave me a comment saying Hi I'd love to hear from you guys I hope you enjoyed the sneak preview of my office and I will see you in the next one.
